content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences is an autonomous super-specialty institute under the GNCT of Delhi and a Deemed-to-be-University recognised by the UGC. It is located at D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi. Its work covers patient care, teaching and research in liver, gall bladder and pancreatobiliary diseases.

content_sections.heading: ILBS Consultant Grade IV Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay figures are pre-revised. The notice says the pay package follows the 7th CPC at the pay level that applies to the Institute. ILBS states that the vacancies may change at any time and that it may choose not to fill a post. A post can be removed from the website once it is filled, and ILBS may add a post if one falls vacant. content_sections.heading: ILBS Consultant Grade IV Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for all three posts is 50 years. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Working knowledge of computers is essential for all the posts. For a post reserved for OBC, ILBS only considers candidates with an OBC certificate issued by the GNCT of Delhi. Candidates with disabilities can apply under the definition in the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995. Only people with at least 40% of the relevant disability get the PWD reservation benefit. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the Recruitment Rules on the ILBS website and the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Screening Committee checks all applications against the Recruitment Rules for the post. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. ILBS may limit the number of candidates called for interview. It can do this by looking for qualifications and experience above the advertised minimum and for other academic achievements. It may reject any application without giving a reason. It will not answer questions about how interviews are run or why a candidate was not called. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Each appointment is on a contract basis for one year. Either side can end the contract with at least three months' notice in writing, or with salary in place of the notice period. The joining date and other conditions follow the Institute's HR policy. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts in Delhi/New Delhi only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ILBS Consultant Grade IV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the Recruitment Rules and the category for your post on the ILBS website to check that you are eligible. Download the application form from the ILBS website and fill it in. Pay the application fee by RTGS/NEFT to the HDFC bank account given above, unless you are exempt. Email the filled form and the documents listed below to [email protected] by 30 October 2026. Documents to send with the application: A recent passport-size photo The date-of-birth entry from your matriculation or SSLC certificate Attested copies of your degree certificate or diploma Photocopies of your testimonials and experience certificates For questions, call the HR department on 011-46300000, extension 23234 or 23233.

faq.question: Q1. Which disciplines are covered by the ILBS Consultant Grade IV posts?
faq.answer: The three disciplines are Radiology (post code Cons/06/Radio), Clinical Genetics (Cons/06/Cl. Gene) and Nuclear Medicine (Cons/06/Nuc. Med.).

faq.question: Q2. Are any of the posts reserved?
faq.answer: No. All three posts are listed as 1-UR, which means they are unreserved.

faq.question: Q3. How much is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: SC/ST, EWS and Ex-Serviceman candidates pay Rs. 118/-. Persons with disabilities pay nothing.

faq.question: Q4. How do I pay the fee?
faq.answer: Pay by RTGS/NEFT to HDFC bank account No. 50100143852078, IFSC HDFC0000273, at the Vasant Kunj branch.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for OBC candidates with a disability?
faq.answer: They get 8 years of relaxation on the 50-year limit. SC/ST candidates with a disability get 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract runs for one year. Either side can end it with three months' written notice or salary in place of notice.

faq.question: Q7. Which proof of date of birth is accepted?
faq.answer: Send the date-of-birth entry from your matriculation or SSLC certificate, along with a recent passport-size photo.

faq.question: Q8. Is computer knowledge needed?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says working knowledge of computers is essential for all the posts.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact with questions?
faq.answer: Call the ILBS HR department on 011-46300000, extension 23234 or 23233.
